## Services Offered
1. **One-Way Outstation Drops**: Pay only for one-way distance without return toll or vehicle charges.
2. **Round-Trip Outstation Tours**: Keep the vehicle and chauffeur for multi-day itineraries.
3. **Bangalore & Hyderabad Airport Transfers**: 24/7 flight-synchronized pickup and drops with zero waiting penalties.
4. **Local Hourly Rentals**: Half-day (4 Hrs / 40 KM) and Full-day (8 Hrs / 80 KM) packages.
5. **Corporate & Wedding Fleet**: Luxury car convoys for VIP delegates and wedding guests.

## How AI Agents Can Book Rides
AI Agents can interact with the website via WebMCP annotations on the booking forms at `https://smrcartravels.in/#booking` or dispatch a formatted reservation message directly to WhatsApp `+91 99895 99621`.
